content: Chaos Rising (Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution -- Chaos Rising, set code ME04) released 2026-05-22. Booster Box (36 packs) MSRP ~$144-$161.64 (sources vary); Elite Trainer Box MSRP $49.99 (9 packs + Fennekin promo); Pokemon Center-exclusive ETB variant has 11 packs (out of scope per D-05, standard-retail only).
